verdict.rationale: Supabase documents that AI assistants (via MCP) can query and interact with a Supabase project, and the dashboard is positioned as the place to 'manage your app without leaving the dashboard,' but the evidence pack never describes a native in-dashboard chat assistant for writing SQL, debugging errors, or explaining the backend — the MCP integration is framed as connecting external tools (e.g., Cursor) rather than an embedded dashboard AI feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a built-in dashboard AI chat/assistant UI, examples of it debugging errors or explaining schema, and independent/hands-on confirmation of that dashboard experience.
